assessments.name: Practice quiz
assessments.description: At the end of every two-week block, students are encouraged to complete a quiz to practice their understanding of the material. The first quiz is due end of Week 2, to get feedback early. Other quizzes due: Week 4, 6, 8, 10.
assessments.dueRaw: Week 02 Due date : 08 Mar 2026 at 23:59 Closing date : 05 Jun 2026

assessments.name: Take-home exam
assessments.description: Take-home exam. Generative AI can be used for Proof reading the material and to search for information that is used to answer the questions. Students must declare how they have used generative AI to complete the assessment.
assessments.dueRaw: Week 06 Due date : 02 Apr 2026 at 23:59 Closing date : 17 Apr 2026

assessments.name: Data Analysis + Written Work
assessments.description: Students will analyse data with statistical software and write up results. This task is a written work assessment.
assessments.dueRaw: Week 12 Due date : 18 May 2026 at 23:59 Closing date : 19 May 2025

assessments.name: Presentation of research article
assessments.description: Each student will be part of a group to present 1 research article (Weeks 11-13) - please upload your presentation onto Canvas
assessments.dueRaw: Week 13 Due date : 29 May 2026 at 23:59 Closing date : 05 Jun 2026

assessments.name: Presentation of research article Submission
assessments.description: Group needs to submit a one-page cheat sheet about the research article that  members present in Week 11-13. Cheat sheet includes information on: 1. Research question, 2. Motivation, 3. Methods (Data & statistical model), 4. Main results, 5. Conclusion
assessments.dueRaw: Week 13 Due date : 01 Jun 2026 at 23:59 Closing date : 05 Jun 2026
